-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies API keys and connectivity.

file-to-markdown.name: file-to-markdown
file-to-markdown.description: Convert a file to text/Markdown (synchronous). PDF and Word .docx are extracted locally; scanned PDFs fall back to LLM OCR if a system key is set. Use file-to-markdown-async for long-running jobs.

params.inputPath: Path to the file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)
params.chunkSize: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10). Only used for PDFs >3MB
params.maxRetries: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)
params.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds per chunk (default: 120000 for chunks, 180000 for direct processing)

file-to-markdown-async.name: file-to-markdown-async
file-to-markdown-async.description: Convert a file to Markdown asynchronously (non-blocking). Supports PDF and Word .docx. Returns a job ID immediately. Use get-job-status to check progress.

params.inputPath: Path to the file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)
params.chunkSize: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10)
params.maxRetries: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)

get-job-status.name: get-job-status
get-job-status.description: Get the status of an async job. Returns current progress, status, and results when completed.

params.jobId: The job ID returned by file-to-markdown-async

list-jobs.name: list-jobs
list-jobs.description: List all jobs with optional filters. Useful for checking active jobs or recent completions.

params.status: Filter by status: queued, processing, completed, failed, cancelled
params.limit: Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 20)

cancel-job.name: cancel-job
cancel-job.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. Cannot cancel completed/failed jobs.

audio-to-text.name: audio-to-text
audio-to-text.description: Transcribe audio files to text using OpenAI Whisper API. Supports .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .ogg, .webm, .opus and other audio formats.

params.inputPath: Path to the audio file to transcribe
params.language: Optional: Language code (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'en' for English). Auto-detected if not provided.

svg-to-png.name: svg-to-png
svg-to-png.description: Convert SVG files to PNG with optional width/height constraints

params.inputPath: Path to the SVG file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .png extension)

name: File Processor
description: Convert files to Markdown, transcribe audio, convert Markdown to PDF

changelog.notes: Initial release — convert documents to Markdown, transcribe audio to text, and turn SVGs into PNG images
